text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT P1: Elevated 5xx + timeouts observed on inference-prod. Auto-paging #incidents and notifying on-call. Root: 1765556666

maya: saw a sudden spike in 502/504 starting ~08:43 UTC. Error rate jumped from ~0.7% to ~11% in 5m. Tail latencies also spiking. Kicking SRE paging.

sahil: I'm on it — initial checks: are these gateway 502s or backend 504s? any pattern to model/route?

obs-bot: alert: gateway_error_rate(502): 0.6% -> 11.3% in 5m. Top offending route: /v1/generate (model=gptx-3b, shard=shard-12).

katy: checking scheduler metrics — queue length for shard-12 jumped to ~18k, avg batch wait ~560ms, 95th batch wait >1.2s. I see large KV-cache priming happening on a few model shards causing long-running batches. Likely head-of-line blocking for small requests.

sahil: good find. mitigation plan: 1) throttle long-running priming tasks, 2) reduce batch sizes for affected scheduler, 3) enable short-term fallback route. Anyone able to run the change?

leo: I can spin burst capacity on dedicated pool. Starting autoscale: `rcli scale --pool=dedicated-inference-1 --delta=+4` (ETA ~90s).

maya: Support report: multiple customers report 504s and client retries. Jordan, can you enumerate impacted customers?

jordan: Customers with reports: Acme Co (high volume), Shoply, BetaApp, SecureDocs. All showed increased retry rates and front-end timeouts since ~08:43. We've opened tickets and marked high priority.

sahil: applying quick runtime changes now — reduce max_batch_size to 8 and set batch_timeout_ms=20 for shard-12 scheduler. Pushing via infra API.

sahil: command I ran: ```
POST https://infra-api.internal/v1/scheduler/config
Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
{
  "shard": "shard-12",
  "max_batch_size": 8,
  "batch_timeout_ms": 20
}
```

obs-bot: metric update (08:53 UTC): avg 502 rate decreased to 6.2%, batch wait down by ~180ms. Autoscale tasks for dedicated pool started (4 new pods).

katy: also toggled prefix-caching eviction policy to be more conservative to avoid long priming sequences taking up slots. Command: `kubectl patch cm scheduler-config -p '{"data":{"kv_eviction":"conservative"}}'`

maya: temporary routing rule added: large requests (tokens>1024) will be routed to fallback-quantized model gptx-3a to reduce load on priming-heavy shards. Rule live now.

sahil: monitoring — watching for error-rate drop. If we see sustained <1% 5xx for 15m, we'll cautiously revert batching_disable/fallback.

obs-bot: 09:02 UTC snapshot: gateway 502s at 3.1%, 504s 0.9%, p95 latency down 210ms. Queue length for shard-12 fell to ~4k.

jordan: support update: customers notified via email/portal. Tickets created: INC-4321 (Acme), INC-4322 (Shoply), INC-4323 (BetaApp), INC-4324 (SecureDocs).

maya: handoff: I'll be handing to @leo for the night shift in ~25m. Leaving a summary in the incident doc with actions taken and hypotheses.

leo: taking over at 09:10 UTC. I'll keep an eye on rollback sequence: 1) revert batch_timeout and max_batch_size, 2) remove fallback routing, 3) scale down burst nodes once stable.

sahil: hypothesis for postmortem: sudden client traffic pattern + heavy KV-cache priming on shard-12 caused batches to inflate and block small low-latency requests -> head-of-line blocking -> gateway timeouts. Need to add preemptive eviction and smarter priming throttles.

support-bot: customer comms queued and sent. Four tickets created and assigned to SRE liaison.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigation_in_progress, severity=P1, assigned_to=leo, timestamp=1765557030

maya: keeping thread open until handoff complete. Please annotate any additional observations.
